subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) He was called Shilpacharya meaning 'great teacher of art' in Bangladesh. (b) It intensified the non-cooperation movement against the Pakistan regime. (c) The exhibition was a symbol to protest and a milestone for cultural freedom. (d) Zainul Abedin is considered the pioneer of Bangladeshi art. (e) He organized the Nabanna (harvest) exhibition in 1969. (f) He was the founder Principal of the first art school in Dhaka. (g) In the exhibition, a 65-foot long scroll was used to portray the poverty in East Pakistan. (h) He was an artist of outstanding talent and earned international reputation. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 d h f a e c g b Zainul Abedin is considered the pioneer of Bangladeshi art. He was an artist of outstanding talent and earned international reputation. He was the founder Principal of the first art school in Dhaka. He was called Shilpacharya meaning ‘great teacher of art' in Bangladesh. He organized the Nabanna (harvest) exhibition in 1969. The exhibition was a symbol to protest and a milestone for cultural freedom. In the exhibition, a 65-foot long scroll was used to portray the poverty in East Pakistan. It intensified the non-cooperation movement against the Pakistan regime. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 238
